findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_client · Private data: finalize_offer, discard_draft, create_client, update_client, update_product, get_recent_offers, set_offer_status, update_profile · Public sink: get_client · Destructive: discard_draft, validate_uid.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_client · Private data: finalize_offer, discard_draft, create_client, update_client, update_product, get_recent_offers, set_offer_status, update_profile · Public sink: get_client · Destructive: discard_draft, validate_uid

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
